success.description: Agility 4+, not encumbered, Coordination trained. Declared as a target of a Melee Attack, Ranged Attack, or a Spell/Blessing that targets your defence. Add two recharge tokens to this card to add {Dc} to the action’s dice pool.

reckless.requirements: Agility 4+, not encumbered, Coordination trained. Effect: After you have been declared the target of a Melee Attack, Ranged Attack, or a Spell/Blessing that targets your defence, add two recharge tokens to this card to add {Dr} to the action’s dice pool. Special: If the incoming attack misses, you may immediately perform a free manoeuvre. Improved Dodge replaces Dodge in your deck and Dodge for all action counts as Improved Dodge for effects that reference it.
